A.name: Stack A: Sovereign Growth & Experimentation
A.tagline: Mautic runs omnichannel drips, GrowthBook runs Bayesian A/B ad tests, Umami tracks conversions, Shlink attributes every ad click.

B.name: Stack B: Agentic Multi-Angle Ad & Funnel
B.tagline: Typebot captures ad traffic via conversational funnels, Listmonk sends zero-tax broadcasts, Matomo tracks funnels, Metabase reports ROAS.

mautic.name: Mautic
mautic.role: Open-source marketing automation, drip campaigns, segments & landing pages
mautic.first_run: Complete the 3-step Mautic web installer using the generated MySQL credentials in tools/mautic/.env.

growthbook.name: GrowthBook
growthbook.role: Bayesian A/B testing, multi-angle ad experimentation & feature flags
growthbook.first_run: Create your local GrowthBook admin account on first visit, then add your ad angle experiments.

umami.name: Umami Analytics
umami.role: Privacy-first real-time conversion, campaign & UTM attribution analytics
umami.first_run: Default local login: username 'admin', password 'umami' (change immediately in Settings).

shlink.name: Shlink
shlink.role: Self-hosted campaign shortlinks & multi-angle ad click attribution
shlink.first_run: Shlink API + Shlink Web Client are wired together; use the INITIAL_API_KEY in tools/shlink/.env.

listmonk.name: Listmonk
listmonk.role: High-throughput self-hosted campaign newsletter & broadcast engine (zero contact tax)
listmonk.first_run: Log in with 'admin' and the generated LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD in tools/listmonk/.env.

matomo.name: Matomo
matomo.role: Full open-source Google Analytics & campaign funnel attribution suite
matomo.first_run: Follow the quick Matomo setup wizard; DB host is 'matomo-db' with credentials from tools/matomo/.env.

typebot.name: Typebot
typebot.role: Interactive conversational ad-landing funnels & lead qualification
typebot.first_run: Open Builder (:5420) to design conversational ad funnels; Viewer serves public bots on :5421.

metabase.name: Metabase
metabase.role: Executive ROAS, CAC & multi-angle A/B ad performance BI dashboards
metabase.first_run: Create your local admin account on first visit and connect your campaign PostgreSQL / MySQL DBs.
